description: Buildings standing in the SCNU 360 VR tour that no GIS건물통합정보 record covers. Footprints are traced by eye on the NGII 2025 orthophoto with the VR view as the reference; floors are counted on the VR facade. Every record is estimated (estimated: true) and its label is shown as an estimate. Merged after gis-buildings.json by stages/sources.mjs (loadVrBuildings); schema in README "VR-only buildings".
sources: SCNU 360 VR tour (visual reference only, nothing copied)
NGII 2025 orthophoto sheet 34702020 (footprints traced by eye, 0.25 m GSD)
